action: As the Israeli Health Ministry instructs, hospital staff must immediately report any deviations in the operation of computer systems.
date_note: The article (27 Nov) says the Health Ministry's cybersecurity department warned on Thursday evening; resolved to 26 Nov. Maccabi's block was on Friday 27 Nov.
exec: Israeli health organisations are restricting remote access as a precaution after an official warning of a possible coordinated attack; no attack is reported as having happened.
org: Israel Ministry of Health; Maccabi Healthcare Services
plain: Israel's Health Ministry warned hospitals of a possible attack on several facilities at once. The Maccabi health fund responded by blocking access to its systems from abroad. No attack has been reported.
summary: IsraelInfo, citing Ynet, reports that the Health Ministry's cybersecurity department warned medical institutions on Thursday evening of a possible attack on the healthcare system, based on information from several sources about plans to hit several facilities at once. The method and the party behind it are unknown, according to the report. On Friday the Maccabi health fund blocked access to its systems from abroad, at least until Sunday.
title: Israel's Health Ministry warns of possible attack on hospitals; Maccabi blocks access to its systems from abroad

validation.note: IsraelInfo (relaying Ynet) and 9tv.co.il both read; both relay the Ministry's warning, whose own notice was not found. 9tv says the urgent notice went out overnight into Friday 27 Nov; IsraelInfo says Thursday evening.

review.note: added 9tv as second source (same warning and Maccabi block); duplicate merged here; validation note updated
